enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +13: Passive: +13 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Nullmagic Guard: On being hit with a spell: There is a small chance that you explode in arcane energies. Foes hit are subject to a silencing effect, preventing their spellcasts and dampening their magical protections for 10 seconds.
Eversight: You benefit from the spell True Seeing and are Immune to Blindness.
Greater Arcane Casting Dexterity: This ability reduces the arcane spell failure chance by -15%.
Quality Potency +14: Passive: +14 Quality bonus to each Spell Power.
Sacred Spell Focus Mastery +1: +1 Sacred bonus to the DC of all spells.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
